items.title: 2.7.2 Subshells aur orbitals mein electrons ka distribution (baant): Aufbau principle (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.7.2, printed pages 34-36.

blocks.text: Kai electrons wale atoms ke orbitals bharne ke liye yeh rules (qaide) istemal hote hain.
Aufbau principle ko building up (tameer karne ka) principle bhi kehte hain.

blocks.title: Aufbau principle
blocks.text: Atom ke subshells electrons se apni energy ke barhte order (tarteeb) mein bharte hain: pehle kam energy wala subshell, phir zyada energy wala.
Ab sawal yeh hai ke subshells ko energy ke hisaab se order mein kaise rakhein?

Magnetic field na ho to subshell ki energy principal quantum number (n) aur azimuthal quantum number (ℓ) dono par depend karti hai. Is liye bharne ka order (n + ℓ) ka sum (jor) nikaal kar maloom hoti hai. (n + ℓ) ki qeematein Table 2.6 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 2.6 Alag subshells ki (n + ℓ) qeematein

items: Jis subshell ka (n + ℓ) kam ho, us ki energy kam hai aur woh pehle bharta hai. Maslan 4s ka (n + ℓ) = 4 + 0 = 4 aur 3d ka 3 + 2 = 5. 4s ka sum kam hai, is liye 4s pehle bharta hai.
Agar do subshells ka (n + ℓ) barabar ho to jis ka n kam ho woh pehle bharta hai. Maslan 4p (4 + 1 = 5) aur 3d (3 + 2 = 5) dono ka sum 5 hai; 3d ka n kam (3) hai, is liye 3d pehle bharta hai.

blocks.text: Is rule ke mutabiq orbitals ki energy ki tarteeb yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Subshells khanon ki qataaron ki shakal mein, har orbital ka ek khaana, zyada energy wala oopar: neeche se oopar 1s, 2s, 2p, 3s, 3p, 4s, 3d, 4p, 5s, 4d, 5p, 6s, 4f, 5d, 6p, 7s, 5f, 6d, 7p. Baen taraf ka arrow (teer) orbital bharne ki tarteeb aur us ke saath rangeen arrow barhti energy dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Fig 2.12: Diagram har subshell ki energy dikhata hai; har khaana ek atomic orbital hai (kitab ki Fig 2.12 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 2.12 mein sab se neeche wale box par ‘1ss’ chhapa hai. Sahi label 1s hai, jaisa upar ki drawing mein hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har box ek orbital hai aur jo box jitna oopar, us ki energy utni zyada. Neeche se oopar parhein to bharne ki tarteeb mil jati hai: 1s, 2s, 2p, 3s, 3p, 4s, 3d, 4p... Dekhein ke 4s, 3d se neeche hai.
Yani is rule se subshells bharne ki tarteeb Figure 2.12 mein di gayi hai.

blocks.prompt: Potassium mein 4s subshell 3d se pehle kyun bharta hai, halanke 3d ka n kam hai?
blocks.explanation: Energy (n + ℓ) se decide hoti hai, sirf n se nahi. 4s ka (n + ℓ) = 4 aur 3d ka 5 hai, is liye 4s ki energy kam hai aur woh pehle bharta hai. Isi liye potassium ka 19wan electron 4s mein jata hai: 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶4s¹.

items: Aufbau: subshells barhti energy ke order mein bharte hain.
(n + ℓ) kam = pehle; barabar ho to kam n pehle.
